 Order
The present petition is filed seeking quashing of FIR No. 266/2018 dated 29.11.2018 for offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station Timarpur.

2. The daughter of Petitioner No. 1 and Respondent No. 2 is present in Court and, on being asked,
states that exaggerated allegations were made by her mother due to matrimonial acrimony.
She submits that she had never objected to the conduct of the father in any manner whatsoever.
3. The complainant is not present in Court.

4. Let the complainant remain present in Court on the next date of hearing.
5.
The petitioners are exempted from personal appearance on the next date of hearing.

6. List on 18.12.2025.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J NOVEMBER 6, 2025/"SS"
